description: February 28 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 1, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 28 birthday falls in Pisces, in the first decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: February 28 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The last day of February in most years falls about nine degrees into Pisces, the closing stretch of its Neptune decan. Twenty-eight reduces to 1, giving the sign a little more backbone than usual. This birthday is often associated with creative independence: an imaginative person who prefers to follow a private vision rather than a crowd.

On February 28 the Sun usually sits at about 9° Pisces, in the first decan, where Neptune rules the decan as well as the sign. Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces, also governs the sign's first decan, from about February 19 to February 28. This is often seen as the most dreamy and boundless part of the zodiac's final sign. Natives tend to be imaginative, compassionate and highly sensitive to music, mood and meaning. They may move through the world like a sponge, absorbing atmosphere and other people's feelings. Doubled Neptune can blur practical edges and make escape tempting when life feels harsh. Creative work, spiritual practice and caring roles often give this decan a way to channel what it senses.

sections.heading: February 28 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 28th reduces as 2 + 8 = 10, then 1 + 0 = 1. The birthday number is 1, but reached by a route that runs through partnership (2) and authority (8). Numerologists often read the 28th as a more cooperative kind of leader than the 1st: independent and ambitious, yet aware that big plans need allies. Those born on this day are frequently described as determined, enterprising and persuasive. As a supporting number, the 28 tends to show in a talent for starting things with others already on board, rather than recruiting help after the fact.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one February 28 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 11 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on February 28: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 28 is the 59th day of the year. By March 21, 22 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Aries.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by February 28, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on February 28 include Linus Pauling (1901), Paul Krugman (1953) and Frank Gehry (1929).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 28?
faq.answer: February 28 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 28?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 28 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 11 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 28th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 28?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a February 28 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 28?
faq.answer: February 28 is also the birthday of Linus Pauling (1901), Paul Krugman (1953) and Frank Gehry (1929). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
